description: This file defines the Image_Graph_Marker class, a data point marker used in graph rendering, including methods for setting size, secondary marker, and drawing the marker.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Marker
classes.description: A class representing a data point marker for graph visualization, supporting secondary markers and customizable size.

methods.name: setSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the marker.

methods.name: _drawMarker
methods.description: Draws the marker at specified coordinates, optionally with additional values.

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Indicates completion of drawing, always returns true.
